title: Thinking levels: accuracy vs time for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
setup: Router with the production section of Qwen3.6. 10 'easy' and 8 'hard' problems with a single checkable answer (multi-step arithmetic, logic, what a code snippet prints, a bug, a SQL query, schedules, counting, probability); one run per setting, fixed seed, hard cap of 4,500 generated tokens; only the final content is graded. Levels: off = chat_template_kwargs {enable_thinking:false}; low/medium/high = enable_thinking:true + thinking_budget_tokens 512/2048/8192; base = no control (server default budget 8192).

easy_10.note: High: one problem (change-making) thought 81 s and was cut at 4,500 tokens without answering.

hard_8.note: High: its single failure was a reasoning run cut at 4,500 tokens.

title_request.description: Time to generate a 5-word session title (agent harness title request: max_completion_tokens 4096, no thinking control).

qwen38_notes.template_reasoning_effort: xhigh (default) | medium | low; any other value raises an exception -> HTTP 500 ('Unexpected reasoning effort high. Supported types are xhigh (default), medium, and low')
qwen38_notes.mapping: client 'high' -> reasoning_effort xhigh; client off -> enable_thinking:false

source: Internal report 25 (2026-10-23) and its quality-vs-speed batteries.
